scope: Completed Phase 2 local defensive SYN fixtures

findings.problem: HTTP readers could buffer bodies without a byte/deadline/admission bound.
findings.fix: Shared byte-bounded request reader, 5s deadline, 64 active readers per Node context, route-specific caps; machine triggers accept only empty or exact {}.
limits: 64 is per Node context, not a distributed tenant quota.

findings.problem: A signed private download remained usable after membership revocation.
findings.fix: Migration 0041 prohibits single, bulk and image signed downloads for vexa-private; authenticated downloads recheck current membership.
limits: Existing issued URLs require proven expiry or separately authorized invalidation before a deployed revocation claim.

findings.problem: A thrown runtime close left the hosted imports admission flag permanently active.
findings.fix: Nested finally always releases the flag, including failed close.

findings.problem: Five development-only transitive audit alerts share braces 3.0.3 as root dependency.
limits: No compatible upstream correction found at audit time; production audit reports zero alerts.
No blanket reachability exemption or downgrade accepted.
findings.reachabilityReview: Current and inherited ESLint config do not configure settings.next.rootDir, the only plugin call site using fast-glob; no untrusted HTTP/CRM input path identified. Reassess if config or dependency use changes. Full audit remains FAIL.

findings.problem: The new global Next header policy replaced the existing stricter brief attachment CSP in actual HTTP responses.
findings.fix: A later exact brief-export route entry preserves the strict attachment policy while retaining common headers.
limits: Regression introduced during this local phase and caught before deployment; same HTTP oracle passes without weakening the policy.

controlIncidents.fix: Same committed source in isolated worktree with npm ci offline; 2688 source hashes unchanged; all 21 email tests then full global gate pass
